note: Section rules (owner-directed 2026-10-24): (1) Flourishing & Wisdom is the flagship first section - the eudaimonic trio. (2) The Extended Evolutionary Meta Model section holds EXACTLY the model's own dossiers: the six ACASMO dimensions (Affect, Cognition, Attention, Self, Motivation, Behaviour) plus its two levels of selection (Body = biophysiological, Others = sociocultural) - nothing else ever goes in it. (3) Themed sections are reader-facing life themes holding the SPECIFIC dossiers, not the EEMM umbrellas: The Affective Life (specific affective states), The Mind's Life (deciding, aiming, willing), Life Challenges (cross-cutting challenges). (4) A themed section must hold at least three dossiers a reader would expect together; a new theme is minted only when three or more planned dossiers cluster, otherwise the candidate sits in the backlog. (5) A family umbrella stays in the EEMM section; its specific family members live in the themed section (e.g. Affect is EEMM, Anger is The Affective Life).

dossiers.title: Genuine Flourishing
dossiers.scope: The flagship dossier: what flourishing genuinely is (versus its counterfeit versions), across philosophy and psychological science. Must set out its boundary against Happiness (hedonic vs eudaimonic material) explicitly.
dossiers.question_draft: What does it actually take for a life to go well, and how is the genuine article told apart from its counterfeits?

dossiers.title: Wisdom
dossiers.scope: Phronesis, wise-reasoning research, the mean, practical judgement in the moment. Earlier working title 'Wisdom and Judgement'.
dossiers.question_draft: What is wisdom doing when it judges, and can it be cultivated or only matured?

dossiers.title: Life's Purpose
dossiers.scope: Purpose and meaning in life: purpose research, Frankl, purpose as an orientation toward something beyond the self. Boundary against Meaning & Mortality (backlog) to be decided when both exist.
dossiers.question_draft: What is a life for, and where does a sense of purpose come from?

dossiers.title: Affect
dossiers.scope: The overarching dossier for affective states: affect as information, constructed emotion, affect regulation, valence and arousal. Umbrella that disambiguates the family (anger, anxiety, happiness...) without absorbing them.
dossiers.question_draft: What is an emotion made of, and what is it telling the person who feels it?

dossiers.title: Anger
dossiers.scope: Published v2 dossier (2026-10-23). Its 'nearby terms' treatment of irritation/resentment/contempt is the pattern for the family.

dossiers.title: Anxiety
dossiers.scope: First dossier of the disambiguation programme: an explicit 'Nearby terms' section must examine Stress, Worry and Angst from opened sources and state what the wiki holds on each, before any split into separate dossiers is decided. See docs/enrichment/dossiers/DISAMBIGUATION.md.
dossiers.question_draft: What is anxiety protecting or preparing us for, and when does it stop serving the person who carries it?

dossiers.title: Happiness
dossiers.scope: Happiness as the affective state and its research (hedonic adaptation, subjective well-being), with an explicit boundary against Genuine Flourishing (eudaimonic material lives there).
dossiers.question_draft: What is happiness made of, and why does it slip away when it is chased?

dossiers.title: Cognition
dossiers.scope: Thinking styles, reasoning, belief formation, the limits of reason. Contains the 'thoughts' territory the owner named.
dossiers.question_draft: How does thinking work, and where does it reliably fail?

dossiers.title: Decision-Making
dossiers.scope: Heuristics, biases, choice overload and architecture, fast-and-frugal models, akrasia. Overlaps with Cognition are resolved by pointing decision research here and reasoning styles at Cognition.
dossiers.question_draft: How does a person choose well under uncertainty, and what gets in the way?

dossiers.title: Attention
dossiers.scope: Focused-attention meditation, attention restoration, mind-wandering, flow, the economy of the gaze. Contains the 'concentration' territory the owner named.
dossiers.question_draft: What is attention, what does it cost, and what does it build?

dossiers.title: The Self
dossiers.scope: Published v2 exemplar (2026-10-23). 140 concept cards + 16 kernels + 2 sayings across ten subthemes.

dossiers.title: Motivation
dossiers.scope: Intrinsic and identified motivation, self-concordance, willpower, desire and craving. Umbrella distinct from Goals.
dossiers.question_draft: What moves a person, and which movements of the heart are worth trusting?

dossiers.title: Goals
dossiers.scope: Goal setting, goal pursuit, goal conflict, attainment and disengagement. Kept separate from Motivation per advisor direction (owner asked for both).
dossiers.question_draft: How do aims shape a life, and when is the right move to drop one?

dossiers.title: Agency
dossiers.scope: Containing Autonomy and Competence: agency as effective power (Dewey), locus of control, self-efficacy, autonomy and competence as basic needs (SDT).
dossiers.question_draft: How much say does a person have over their own life, and what grows that say?

dossiers.title: Behaviour
dossiers.scope: Overt behaviour and habit territory: habit formation, the habit body, discontinuity, returning after lapse. Habit may become a focused dossier later; Behaviour is the EEMM-named umbrella.
dossiers.question_draft: How do repeated actions become a life, and how does a stuck pattern change?

dossiers.title: Others
dossiers.scope: The sociocultural lens: relationships, compassion for others, social baseline, interdependence. Replaces the EEMM 'Sociocultural' label per owner.
dossiers.question_draft: What do other people do to a person's mind and flourishing, and what does one person owe another?

dossiers.title: Body
dossiers.scope: The biophysiological lens: interoception, stress physiology, embodiment, breath. Replaces the EEMM 'Biophysiological' label per owner.
dossiers.question_draft: What does the body know, and how does it participate in suffering and flourishing?

dossiers.title: Uncertainty
dossiers.scope: Living with uncertainty: tolerance of uncertainty, probabilistic thinking, impermanence, security vs groundlessness. Cross-cutting theme, deliberately not forced into one EEMM band.
dossiers.question_draft: Can a person live well without knowing what comes next?

dossiers.title: Overload & Overwhelm
dossiers.scope: The overwhelming world: information overload, cognitive load, burnout, demands and resources, saturation. Cross-cutting theme.
dossiers.question_draft: When the world gives more than a person can take in, what still works?

backlog: Habit (focused, if Behaviour grows too large)
Desire & Craving (if Motivation grows too large)
